items.question: A man and a woman are planning their summer holiday.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Have you thought about where we should go in the summer?

script.speaker: man
script.text: Yes, I'd like to go to the seaside. I want to lie on the beach and swim every day.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: That sounds nice, but I get bored on the beach after two days. I'd rather visit a city, with museums and old streets.

script.speaker: man
script.text: We could do both. There are some nice cities near the coast, like Valencia.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Good idea. How much can we spend?

script.speaker: man
script.text: About six hundred pounds for the week, not more. I've spent a lot of money this year.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Me too, so let's find a cheap hotel. I don't need anything fancy.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Neither do I. But I'd like a room with a balcony, if possible.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I don't mind. I can book it tonight on my laptop. Shall we go by plane or by train?

script.speaker: man
script.text: I don't mind. Which do you prefer?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I'm afraid of flying, so I prefer the train, even if it's slower.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Then let's take the train. I like looking out of the window anyway.

statements.text: Would like to go to the beach every day.

explanation.en: The man wants to lie on the beach and swim every day. The woman gets bored there after two days.
explanation.es: El hombre quiere tumbarse en la playa y nadar cada día. La mujer se aburre allí a los dos días.

statements.text: Does not like travelling by plane.

explanation.en: The woman says she is afraid of flying. The man says he doesn't mind how they travel.
explanation.es: La mujer dice que le da miedo volar. El hombre dice que le da igual cómo viajar.

statements.text: Has spent a lot of money recently.

explanation.en: The man says he has spent a lot this year and the woman answers: "Me too".
explanation.es: El hombre dice que ha gastado mucho este año y la mujer responde: "Me too".

statements.text: Would like a room with a balcony.

explanation.en: The man asks for a balcony. The woman says she doesn't mind.
explanation.es: El hombre pide un balcón. A la mujer le da igual.

items.question: A woman asks a man about the new gym in town.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Hi Dan, I heard you joined the new gym on Park Road.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Yes, I joined two weeks ago. I go three times a week after work.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Is it expensive? I'd like to join, but I haven't got much money.

script.speaker: man
script.text: It's thirty pounds a month. That includes the swimming pool and some classes.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: That's not bad. Is it busy?

script.speaker: man
script.text: In the evening, yes. It's full between six and eight. I usually go later, at about nine, and then there's plenty of space.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I finish work at five, so I could go at half past five.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Then you'll have to wait for the machines. Or you could try the morning. They open at six.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Six! I'm not a morning person at all. I think I'll go at lunchtime instead. My office is only ten minutes away.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Good idea. By the way, the classes are great. I did a yoga class last week and my back feels better already.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I've never done yoga. Maybe I'll try it with you one day.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Sure! I'm going to the Saturday class this weekend, if you'd like to come.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I'd love to. Send me the time later.

statements.text: Is already a member of the gym.

explanation.en: The man says he joined two weeks ago. The woman would like to join, but she has not joined yet.
explanation.es: El hombre dice que se apuntó hace dos semanas. La mujer quiere apuntarse, pero todavía no lo ha hecho.

explanation.en: The woman asks if it is expensive because she hasn't got much money.
explanation.es: La mujer pregunta si es caro porque no tiene mucho dinero.

statements.text: Does not like getting up early.

explanation.en: The woman says she is not a morning person at all and chooses lunchtime. The man only says the gym opens at six.
explanation.es: La mujer dice que no es nada madrugadora y elige la hora de comer. El hombre solo dice que abren a las seis.

statements.text: Plans to go to a class on Saturday.

explanation.en: The man is going to the Saturday class and invites her. The woman says "I'd love to".
explanation.es: El hombre va a la clase del sábado y la invita. La mujer dice "I'd love to".
